content: CDSS-for-triage literature (Fernandes 2020 systematic review, 62 papers): CDSS in the ED improve clinician decision-making and standardise prioritisation, and intelligent/AI triage tools flag high-risk cases and suggest priority. The consistent design norm is 'assist, not replace' - final decisions stay with trained staff who integrate clinical judgement. Recommended capabilities cluster around consistency/standardisation, risk flagging, and workflow fit.
